endorsements.name: Geovanni Ruiz
endorsements.label: CVE-2021-47944
endorsements.description: memono Notepad 4.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to crash the application by pasting excessively long character buffers into note fields. Attackers can generate a payload containing 350000 repeated characters and paste it twice into a new note to trigger an application crash on iOS devices.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.7)
